safe_order: Obtain the authoritative field proposal and 100-record sample; lock exact SQL identifiers, meanings, types, nullability, and fallback contract before implementation.

Define additive nullable schema changes and update/recreate ai_complete_trump_data so all six columns are available without renaming/removing synopsis or impact_scope; verify grants and view dependency behavior in a separately authorized migration plan.

Update generated/manual TypeScript row contracts and API DTOs. Add fields to explicit SELECT projections, especially /api/catalog-data and /api/entries; decide whether query/search matches short/medium text and keep result/count predicates identical.

Implement a dual-read display fallback (new v2 field when non-empty, otherwise current synopsis / existing impact score behavior) in cards, dossier and share output; do not silently reinterpret numeric impact_scope as impact prose.

If chat/RAG is intended to consume the fields, extend ingestion payload normalization and vector metadata with a defined version/fallback policy, then update retrieval and tooltip consumers; reindex only after payload QA and with a rollback path.

Run a read-only comparison on the exact 100-row sample: missing/null distribution per field, lengths, unicode, field-to-record alignment, old/new fallback output, query/API serialization and card rendering. Keep the sample ID/hash in QA evidence.
Backfill only after sample acceptance, in resumable batches with row counts and idempotency; verify view/API parity and fallback counts before switching canonical reads.
Remove legacy fallback only after coverage is demonstrated and consumers are migrated; this audit does not authorize schema or data changes.
non_scope: No canonical records, scores, merge, PR, or other-worker output changes
conclusion: Repository compatibility is incomplete: explicit APIs, types, write/ingest paths, cards, and chat/RAG rely on legacy synopsis/impact_scope.
